prophets.name: Adam, peace be upon him
prophets.people: His descendants; the Qur'an does not mention a particular people for him

book.text: No book is named for him

prophets.sinsAndPunishment: He had no denying people in the usual sense; what occurred was the account of Iblis and the whispering to Adam and Eve
prophets.message: The oneness of God, obedience to Him, and repentance when one errs
prophets.placeText: Paradise, then the earth; the Qur'an does not specify where he descended

prophets.name: Idris, peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions neither his people nor any punishment of a denying people
prophets.message: Truthfulness, uprightness and worship; God says: “Lo! he was a saint, a prophet” (Maryam 19:56)

prophets.name: Nuh (Noah), peace be upon him

book.text: No book is named for him

prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Associating partners with God and idol worship, denial and arrogance; **they were drowned in the flood**
prophets.message: The oneness of God, abandoning idol worship, seeking forgiveness, and warning of the punishment
prophets.placeText: The Qur'an does not specify his land precisely

prophets.name: Hud, peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Associating partners with God, arrogance, force and violence, and denial; they were destroyed **by the barren wind**
prophets.message: Worship of God alone, abandoning arrogance, and gratitude for blessings
prophets.placeText: **Al-Ahqaf**; most probably the south of the Arabian Peninsula

prophets.name: Salih, peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Associating partners with God, denial, and **the hamstringing of the she-camel**; the blast and the earthquake seized them, and they perished
prophets.message: Oneness of God, abandoning corruption, and respect for God's sign, the she-camel
prophets.placeText: **Al-Hijr** in the north-west of the Arabian Peninsula

prophets.name: Ibrahim (Abraham), peace be upon him
prophets.people: His people, among them idol worshippers; he then called to the oneness of God

book.text: **The Scriptures of Ibrahim**, mentioned in the Qur'an

prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Associating partners with God and idol worship; his people tried to burn him, and God saved him
prophets.message: Debating the polytheists, dismantling the arguments of association, devoting worship purely to God, and building the Sacred House
prophets.placeText: Iraq / Mesopotamia, then al-Sham and Mecca

prophets.name: Lut (Lot), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Indecency, waylaying travellers, open display of wrongdoing, and denial; **their cities were overturned and rained upon with stones**
prophets.message: Oneness of God, purity, and abandoning indecency
prophets.placeText: The cities of the people of Lut, in the Dead Sea region according to the best-known view

prophets.name: Isma'il (Ishmael), peace be upon him
prophets.people: His descendants, the people of Mecca and those around them
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no people who denied him, and no collective punishment for them
prophets.message: Prayer and almsgiving, truthfulness and keeping one's covenant: “he was a keeper of his promise” (Maryam 19:54)

prophets.name: Ishaq (Isaac), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no particular people who denied him
prophets.message: A continuation of the call of Ibrahim and of the oneness of God

prophets.name: Ya'qub (Jacob, Israel), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no punishment of his people in his time
prophets.message: Oneness of God, worship, and his charge to his sons to hold fast to the religion of God

prophets.name: Yusuf (Joseph), peace be upon him
prophets.people: The people of Egypt, and his household from the Children of Israel
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no people punished for denying him
prophets.message: Oneness of God, chastity, trustworthiness, patience, forgiveness, and the administration of the affairs of state

prophets.name: Ayyub (Job), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no punishment of his people
prophets.message: Patience in affliction, turning to God, and not despairing
prophets.placeText: Not specified in the Qur'an; traditionally attributed to the region of al-Sham

prophets.name: Shu'ayb, peace be upon him
prophets.people: **Midian and the Companions of the Thicket**
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Associating partners with God, **giving short measure and weight, depriving people of their due, and spreading corruption in the land**; the earthquake and the punishment of the Day of the Shadow seized them, according to the Qur'anic context
prophets.message: Oneness of God, economic justice, giving full measure and weight, and refraining from corruption
prophets.placeText: **Midian**, in the north-west of the Arabian Peninsula according to the best-known view

prophets.name: Musa (Moses), peace be upon him
prophets.people: **Pharaoh and his people, and the Children of Israel**
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Pharaoh: tyranny, the claim to supremacy, the killing of the sons, and the enslavement of the Children of Israel; God destroyed him **by drowning**. Among the Children of Israel there occurred association with God in the worship of the calf, and other things
prophets.message: Oneness of God, freeing the Children of Israel from oppression, and establishing the law of God

prophets.name: Harun (Aaron), peace be upon him
prophets.people: **The Children of Israel**; together with Musa he called Pharaoh and his people
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The same context as the mission of Musa; among the most prominent events among his people was the worship of the calf
prophets.message: Oneness of God, supporting Musa, and leading the Children of Israel upon the law of God

prophets.name: Dawud (David), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no particular people punished for denying him
prophets.message: Worship and ruling with justice, glorifying God, and justice among people

prophets.name: Sulayman (Solomon), peace be upon him
prophets.people: The Children of Israel; he ruled over a wide realm of humans, jinn and birds

book.text: No book is named for him

prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no people punished for denying him; among the events is his encounter with the Queen of Sheba and her people, and their worship of the sun
prophets.message: Oneness of God, gratitude for blessing, justice, and using kingship in obedience to God

prophets.name: Ilyas (Elijah), peace be upon him
prophets.people: His people from the Children of Israel, who worshipped **Baal**
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The worship of Baal and denial; the Qur'an gives no detail of a collective punishment for them
prophets.message: Oneness of God and abandoning the worship of Baal
prophets.placeText: Greater Syria (al-Sham) according to the best-known view

prophets.name: Al-Yasa' (Elisha), peace be upon him
prophets.people: His people are not specified in detail; from the Children of Israel according to the best-known view
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions neither the disobedience of his people nor their punishment
prophets.message: Uprightness and righteousness; the Qur'an describes him as among the best
prophets.placeText: Greater Syria (al-Sham) according to the best-known view

prophets.name: Yunus (Jonah), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: They denied at first, then **believed before the punishment came down**, and so God lifted the punishment from them
prophets.message: Oneness of God, warning and repentance; his people are a rare example of a people who believed after their prophet's warning, so that God lifted the punishment from them
prophets.placeText: **Nineveh, Iraq** according to the best-known view

prophets.name: Dhu al-Kifl, peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no people and no punishment for them
prophets.message: Patience, righteousness and faithfulness; God says: “All were of the steadfast” (Al-Anbiya 21:85)

prophets.name: Zakariyya (Zechariah), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an mentions no people punished for denying Zakariyya
prophets.message: Worship, supplication, the care of Maryam, and holding fast to obedience to God

prophets.name: Yahya (John), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: The Qur'an gives no detail of a punishment of his people; a faction of the Children of Israel killed him according to the historical reports, but the details of that are not in the Qur'an
prophets.message: God-consciousness, chastity, righteousness, and holding fast to the Book of God

prophets.name: 'Isa (Jesus), peace be upon him
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Denial, the killing of prophets, and the attempt to kill 'Isa; God raised 'Isa to Himself, and they did not kill him
prophets.message: Oneness of God, confirming the Torah, correcting deviation, giving glad tidings of the Messenger Muhammad ﷺ, mercy and worship

prophets.name: Muhammad ﷺ
prophets.people: First **Quraysh and the Arabs**, then **all people**
prophets.sinsAndPunishment: Associating partners with God, idol worship, injustice, and various forms of social corruption; God granted victory to His Messenger and Mecca was conquered, and then people entered Islam in throngs
prophets.message: Oneness of God, the seal of prophethood, the Qur'an, worship, moral character, justice, the reform of society, and belief in all the prophets
